title: Sandslash’s Broken Claws Return the Next Day

direction.premise: Sandslash can snap off its claws and spikes, yet they grow back the very next day.
direction.audiencePromise: See why breaking Sandslash’s weapons is only a temporary problem.
direction.openLoop: How can Sandslash keep fighting after losing its claws and spikes?
direction.payoff: Its broken claws and spikes grow back in a day, leaving Sandslash unbothered.
direction.engagementQuestion: Smart recovery, or a terrible weakness?

voice.instructions: Use a quick, tense pace with crisp emphasis on broken, one day, and grow back. Pause briefly before each reveal.

scenes.headline: BROKEN CLAWS. ONE DAY.
scenes.narration: What if breaking your claws lasted just one day?
scenes.caption: BROKEN CLAWS. ONE DAY.

scenes.headline: DIG TOO FAST, SNAP THEM OFF
scenes.narration: Sandslash may snap off its spikes and claws digging too fast.
scenes.caption: DIGGING CAN BREAK BOTH

scenes.headline: ITS WEAPONS JUST BROKE
scenes.narration: Bad news for a Pokémon that attacks with both.
scenes.caption: ITS WEAPONS ARE GONE

scenes.headline: THE DAMAGE DOESN’T LAST
scenes.narration: The Pokédex says broken claws and spikes grow back in a day.
scenes.caption: GROW BACK IN A DAY

scenes.headline: SANDSLASH IS FINE AGAIN
scenes.narration: By the next day, Sandslash is not bothered by losing them.
scenes.caption: DAY ONE: BROKEN  •  NEXT DAY: FINE

scenes.headline: RECOVERY OR WEAKNESS?
scenes.narration: Smart recovery, or a terrible weakness?
scenes.caption: SMART RECOVERY OR WEAKNESS?
